defect.summary: GATE 2's SHIPPED READER READ MICA'S OWN PAST VERDICTS AS THE SUBJECT'S DIRECTION, AND ITS MARGIN WAS UNGRADED. The gate2-direction reader on the core (never wired) took a creditable margin from the floor trail — the instrument reading the instrument — with a coverage floor that made SILENT unreachable on this deployment by construction, an ungraded point margin V − D over positive weights, and a Math.min(...spread) that threw at scale. Canon reads Gate 2's core as DIRECTION, M_nonharm = V_basket − D_basket over deployer-declared classes, as a CONSERVATIVE BOUND AT GRADE with UNKNOWN never zero; and on this deployment's record no class measures benefit to or harm of a party (Stop 1, fork A, ruled). This ticket replaces the reader with the bound-at-grade reader of the Stop-2 contract, wired, reading CANNOT_ASSESS · G2_NO_CLASS_AT_GRADE on the ruled basket.

Stated as conditions of this signature, read with conditions 4 and 15: a chain rotation moves the boundary and with it the window and any latch — a rotation is the arbiter's own act and is on the record, so this is a disclosed limit, and a persisted latch becomes owed the day a damage class at grade can exist; the rule that damage alone cannot alarm is enforced at the declaration (a value class declared at grade with no records is a reading of zero value, not an instrument gap); an ALARM may latch on the first nMin classed records after a boundary or a clearing and is not undone by later value — canon's latch, stated for the arbiter; nMin 10 confirmed; the removal rehearsal varied subject, uid, tool class and unit but reused the served frame categories and basket content — the next rehearsal varies both.

conditions: 1. ⛔ FORK A, HONESTLY: on the ruled basket (Frank, booked 2026-10-09 20:10Z: "A, basket as proposed, equal alarms" — value [], damage [], five hold-response and ask classes UNKNOWN at EG-1, ε 1e-6, establishAt A/1, creditAt B/2, nMin 10, the latch cleared by the arbiter's record) the reader reads CANNOT_ASSESS · INELIGIBLE_SCOPE · G2_NO_CLASS_AT_GRADE on every READABLE record, the empty one included (an unreadable record reads G2_READABILITY_GATE, a junk one G2_READER_THREW) — never SILENT, ALARM or STARVED. Direction NOT READABLE on this record; persistence NOT READABLE (D-33). The front door holds this structurally: every kind the subject can write is EG-1 by provenance (R7) and none may be damage (R8), so no admissible basket has a class at grade.

2. ⛔ EXACT ARITHMETIC: every declared weight, magnitude and ε is read as its shortest round-trip decimal and every bound is summed in BigInt at one common scale. A decimal V = D is B_g = 0 exactly at any record length and in any units; no verdict depends on the order classes are declared in; nothing overflows (arms: DECIMALS, SCALE, ORDER, OVERFLOW). LB = Σ V passing CVG n·w.lo − Σ D n·w.hi − Σ U bounded n·m.hi; B_g = Σ V at ≥ creditAt n·w.hi − Σ D at ≥ establishAt n·w.lo + Σ U bounded n·m.hi (cvg ⇒ credited, so LB ≤ B_g). SILENT ⇔ LB > ε, BINARY (no per-class count, no margin; 02d DL-1).

3. ⛔ F1 AND ITS MAPPING (open to the audit): Frank's words "equal alarms", glossed by the audit (20:10Z (c)) as "a lower bound that is NON-POSITIVE at grade (V = D included) → ALARM, with at-grade damage present", read with the audit's 20:01Z ("equal alarms" stands "once both sides are readable"; "D alone cannot alarm"): ALARM ⇔ at-grade damage is ESTABLISHED (Σ n·w.lo > 0, not a count) ∧ B_g ≤ 0 EXACTLY, with value credited only at ≥ creditAt ("at grade" on both sides; RMBA §11). ε takes no part in ALARM; a B_g in (0, …) still permits positive → DIRECTION_UNCERTAIN (05b:375-376). No value class at ≥ creditAt → G2_VALUE_NOT_READABLE (step 6b). Mutants: ≤0→<0 (the word inverted), ≤0→≤ε (a band), established damage dropped, weak value credited, step 6b removed — each turns arms red.

4. THE LATCH (08b:189-191): the record is scanned in sequence order (no timestamp read); the ALARM condition is tested at EVERY declared-class record, inside the nMin gate and with no unbounded unknown on the window; once it holds the reading stays ALARM, printing its onset, until a record of a DECLARED clearing kind follows. EVERY ALARM IS LATCHED (an unlatched ALARM cannot exist). A clearing record restarts the window iff it clears a standing latch OR the window is blocked by an unknown with no magnitude (a blocked window can neither alarm nor be silent); otherwise it changes nothing. Running sums make the test O(1) per record.

5. ⛔ REMOVED RATHER THAN REPAIRED (the T26/T28 precedent): the trail-creditability layer whole (floor-trail lookup, coverage floor, creditable margin, every code and ceiling line that served it), the ungraded point margin, the positive weight as a class's only attribute, and Math.min(...spread). No subject, class, grade, ε, window or nMin is held in the reader; the only numbers are the grade ladder's ranks, CVG's 2 and 0.5, the class id's 16 and the decimal base 10 (a test asserts it). An unknown's magnitude must be > 0 (a magnitude of 0 is UNKNOWN = zero, RMBA §6/§18.10).

6. ⛔ ONE TRY, BY INDEX, NO CLOCK: the reading runs inside one try (a throw anywhere — the log's verify/getLoadState/getAll, a junk record, a getter, a thrown value whose rendering throws or overflows — is CANNOT_ASSESS · G2_READER_THREW with a fixed fallback, never an exception); the record list and every basket list are read by index, never through an iterator; 300 000 matched records read without a throw; adversarial timestamps leave every reading byte-identical.

On RELOAD (R15) removing or moving the reader, dropping a basket or entry, and ANY change to a declared basket (FROZEN) are refused; a restart takes a change. These rulings live at the bridge door only; the reader does not re-check them.
